full_name: Elizabeth A. Wilson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2011–2012 Humanities Helen Putnam Fellow Emory University
bio: Elizabeth A. Wilson, a professor in the Department of Women’s Studies at Emory University, works in feminist science studies using psychoanalytic theory, affect theory, feminist and queer theory, and contemporary neuroscientific data.
